summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 51% of Yada Commerce Inc. from the founding shareholders for 50,000 restricted shares of NextTrip common stock. No price per share, premium, or dollar value is disclosed. The board of directors did not state a recommendation nor name an advisor. The Founding Shareholders retain operational control despite NextTrip's controlling interest; a five-member board with two designees from each side and a fifth appointed member is established. NextTrip receives a right of first refusal on future Yada share sales and serves as exclusive preferred travel provider. Watch for regulatory clearance, Nasdaq listing compliance, and risk-arb spreads given the stock-only consideration.
